design_philosophy.core_concept: Fast Food x Fine Dining Fusion. We are selling 'Gourmet Tamales', not just street food. The design must feel expensive, moody, and urgent.
design_philosophy.visual_style: Dark Mode Luxury. Deep slate backgrounds, high-contrast white text, and piercing crimson accents. Texture over gradients.

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use 'italic' variants for emphasis words.

primary.name: Tamale Crimson
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Price tags, Active states, Borders on hover

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-8 to p-24 for sections.
spacing.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for cards to prevent text collision.

grids.marketing: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical layouts. 12-column base. Mix wide spans (col-span-8) with narrow spans (col-span-4).
grids.menu: The 'Bento' Grid. Dense, visual cards. Images take up 50% of the card height.
grids.dashboard: The 'Control Room'. High density, sharp edges, minimal gaps (gap-4).

buttons.style: Sharp edges or minimal rounded-md. No pill shapes for this brand.
buttons.primary: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300 font-bold tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: border border-slate-700 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-slate-800 hover:border-slate-600

inputs.style: bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 text-white focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-600 rounded-md h-12

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays on the dark background to prevent banding and add 'film grain' feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows. When a red button glows, the shadow should be red, not black.
visual_enhancers.motion: Slow, cinematic fades. Parallax on scroll for images.

hero_backgrounds.description: Moody red lighting restaurant interior - Perfect for Hero Background
Stylish bar with window light - Good for 'Visit Us' section

food_and_menu.description: Plated Mexican dish on blue ceramic - Use for 'Signature Dish'
Red hot peppers on black - Use for 'Ingredients' or 'Spicy' feature
Pile of red peppers - Texture background

people_and_service.description: Chef preparing food in dark kitchen - Use for 'Our Story' or 'Chef'
Server holding tray - Use for 'Order Online' CTA

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-end, moody restaurant site. Do not make it look like a generic white-background SaaS. Embrace the dark mode.
setup: Ensure Tailwind config includes the custom colors (slate-950, red-600).
implementation_order: 1. Setup global CSS (dark theme default, fonts).
critical_rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-950 (#020617).
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
Use data-testid attributes for all buttons and inputs.

universal_guidelines.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry. Use noise textures.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure red text on dark backgrounds meets contrast ratios. Use lighter reds for text if needed.
